visualContract.layoutPolicy: The selected native scroll specimen supplies 288px extent,8px corner,16px content inset and 6px rounded thumb thickness. Width remains fluid. Source Scrollbar padding 1px makes an8px total bar; actual primitive absolute placement, overflow, proportional thumb length/translation and Corner remain authoritative. Content padding is caller-owned because the wrapper exports no Viewport; Root props do not become Viewport callbacks or labels. The outer section supplies a real heading; Root stays presentational. Viewport becomes a native tab destination only when overflowing. Horizontal ScrollBar is explicitly added in caller children, which this wrapper places inside its Viewport; the wrapper vertical bar remains a Root sibling of that Viewport. Horizontal scrollbar uses column flex flow so flex-1 fills its thickness rather than overriding source-measured thumb width. Focus outline and native links remain meaningful without a draggable visual scrollbar; all text/list content is retained. No fake ARIA scrollbar or Root value/onValueChange is invented. Static thumb dimensions are finite illustrative runtime measurements, not copied node identities.
